janvier_by_verse.2: And Pharao being wrath against them (for the one was chief of the cup-bearers, the other chief baker)
janvier_by_verse.3: he sent them into the prison of the captain of the soldiers, in the which Joseph also was prisoner.
janvier_by_verse.4: But the keeper of the prison delivered them to Joseph, who also ministered to them: some little time was passed, and they were kept in custody.
janvier_by_verse.5: And they saw each of them both a dream in one night, according to an interpretation agreeing to themselves:
janvier_by_verse.6: to whom when Joseph was entered in the morning, and saw them sad,
janvier_by_verse.7: he asked them, saying: Why is your countenance sadder today than it was wont?
janvier_by_verse.8: Who answered: We have seen a dream, and there is nobody to interpret it to us. And Joseph said to them: Why doth not interpretation belong to God? Tell me what you have seen.
janvier_by_verse.9: The chief of the cup-bearers first told his dream: I saw before me a vine,
janvier_by_verse.10: wherein were three branches, growing by little and little into buds, and after the blossoms, the grapes waxed ripe:
janvier_by_verse.11: and the cup of Pharao in my hand: and I took the grapes, and wrung them into the cup which I held, and I gave the cup to Pharao.
janvier_by_verse.12: Joseph answered: This is the interpretation of the dream: The three branches, are yet three days:
janvier_by_verse.13: after the which Pharao will remember thy service, & will restore thee to thy old degree: & thou shalt give him the cup according to thine office, as before thou hadst wont to do.
janvier_by_verse.14: Only remember me, when it shall be well with thee, and do me this mercy, to put Pharao in mind that he take me out of this prison:
janvier_by_verse.15: because I was taken away by stealth, out of the land of the Hebrews, and here an innocent was I cast into the lake.
janvier_by_verse.16: The master of the bakers seeing that he had wisely resolved the dream, he said: And I also saw a dream, that I had three baskets of meal upon my head:
janvier_by_verse.17: and that in one basket that was the higher, I carried all meats that are made by the art of baking, and that the birds did eat out of it.
janvier_by_verse.18: Joseph answered: This is the interpretation of the dream: The three baskets, are yet three days:
janvier_by_verse.19: after the which Pharao will take thy head from thee, and hang thee on the cross, and the fowls shall tear thy flesh.
janvier_by_verse.20: The third day after this was the birth-day of Pharao: who making a great feast to his servants, at the banquet he remembered the master of the cup-bearers, and the chief of the bakers.
janvier_by_verse.21: And he restored the one into his place, to reach him the cup,
janvier_by_verse.22: the other he hanged on a gibbet, that the truth of the interpreter might be approved.
janvier_by_verse.23: And yet notwithstanding the chief of the cup-bearers, prosperous things succeeding, forgat his interpreter.
